$comment: Options Table: a table of valid combinations read by a chain of inputs. `table` is what the author writes, `inputs` the chained inputs' names in wire order, `rows` what goes to the browser (the chain's columns only, each combination once). Each case gives one pick per input (null for none) and expects the options each input offers and the pick it resolves to. Grasshopper narrows in the solve (PickTableLogic), the browser the same way (@selvajs/ui dynamic-value-list.ts); both test suites load this file.

cases.name: with no picks every input takes its first option
a pick narrows every input after it
a pick the earlier picks rule out takes the first option left
a later pick never changes an earlier input

driven.$comment: Style is wired into By: it narrows the rows with the value it holds and is not filled from them. `rows` is unchanged, its first cell now Style's. A By value matches its cell ignoring case.

branching.$comment: Style feeds both Front and Handle, so Handle narrows on Style alone: a front never changes the handles offered.

repeated.$comment: The same chain with a Repeat wired into Front and Handle: each shows once per row of `rowKeys` and every row narrows on its own, starting from what Style left. picks, options and shown hold one list per input, with one entry per row the input shows.
